title: An AI assistant for agile coaches on Mac to manage workflows and meetings
metaTitle: AI assistant for agile coaches: Manage sprints and meetings on Mac
description: Lazur is a voice assistant for agile coaches on Mac. Use it to navigate Jira, Slack, and Zoom, draft retrospectives, and organize your coaching day faster.
intro: Agile coaching requires constant context switching between team communication, project tracking, and deep facilitation work. An AI assistant for agile coaches helps you stay in the flow by handling the administrative friction of your Mac desktop through voice commands.
tldr: Use Lazur to voice-control your Mac and navigate complex tools like Jira or Miro.
Hold Option plus Command to ask questions about anything visible on your screen.
Use the hold function to dictate meeting notes or retrospectives directly into your documents.
Lazur lives in the notch and helps you manage your day without constant manual clicking.
Your privacy is central: Lazur only sees your screen when you explicitly ask it to.

blocks.text: Managing your coaching day on Mac

Your day is defined by meetings and facilitation. You jump from a morning stand-up in Zoom to a backlog refinement session in Jira. Then you move to Slack to address team blockers. This constant movement makes it hard to focus on coaching outcomes. Lazur acts as your interface for these tasks. You hold ⌥ ⌘ to ask about a status or find a specific ticket. You do not need to hunt through tabs. You talk, and Lazur points to the information you need.

Coaches often handle a high volume of administrative work. You track cycle times and identify bottlenecks. You prepare retrospectives and coaching plans. When you use your Mac for these tasks, the time spent clicking through menus adds up. Lazur lets you dictate your findings or ask for guidance on how to perform a specific action in your project management tools. You can ask how to add a label in Linear or how to create a channel in Slack without leaving your current window.

Always check your organization's policy regarding the use of AI tools on company hardware. Do not share sensitive team data or confidential client information with any AI service. Lazur is a local assistant that helps you navigate your interface, but you remain responsible for your data security.
blocks.title: A note on data privacy

blocks.text: Speed matters when you are facilitating a session. If a team member asks about an issue status, you want an answer immediately. Instead of clicking through your board, hold ⌥ ⌘ and ask Lazur to find the issue. Lazur highlights the relevant area on your screen. This keeps the meeting moving and keeps your attention on the team rather than the software interface.

items: Ask about screen content by holding ⌥ ⌘.
Get guidance on complex software tasks by asking how to do them.
Dictate meeting notes and action items using the fn key.
Keep your focus on the team while your Mac handles the UI navigation.

blocks.text: You likely repeat the same administrative steps every sprint. Setting up a new board, creating documentation for a retrospective, or sending recurring reminders in Slack. These tasks are necessary but take away from your actual coaching time. Use Lazur to guide you through these processes. If you are stuck on a specific feature in Notion or Jira, ask Lazur to walk you through it. It will provide the steps one at a time, waiting for you to complete each action.
Working with Slack and project management tools

Slack is where your team lives. Managing multiple channels and responding to blockers requires constant attention. Use Lazur to jump to specific channels or search for recent messages. If you need to document a blockers list, use the dictation feature to write it out quickly. For project management, you can ask Lazur to point at the status field in your issue tracker. This saves you from scrolling through long lists of tickets.

faq.question: Can Lazur edit my Jira tickets for me?
faq.answer: No. Lazur does not click buttons or edit files. It guides you, points at things, and helps you navigate your Mac faster so you can perform the task yourself.

faq.question: Is Lazur safe to use for coaching notes?
faq.answer: Lazur is designed with privacy in mind. It only sees your screen and hears your voice while you hold the activation key. It does not store your data or use it to train AI models.

faq.question: Does Lazur work with all Mac apps?
faq.answer: Lazur works with any app on your Mac. It sees what is on your screen and provides assistance regardless of the software you are using.
